title: Humayun and Sher Shah: more battles, forts and detail

boxes.title: Humayun: more events
head: Event
Fact
rows: Drove **Mahmud Lodi** from **Jaunpur**; lifted Kalinjar siege
Sher Khan accepted supremacy after **four-month** siege
Wife **Hamida Banu Begum**; **Shah Tahmasp** helped retake **Kandahar, Kabul**

boxes.title: Sher Shah & Surs: more
items: Managed father's jagir from **1511**; served Babur; deputy regent of Bihar
Islam Shah = **Jalal Khan**; rivals **Muhammad Adil Shah**, Sikandar Sur
Hemu: Adil Shah's minister; took **Agra, Delhi**; ==arrow in his eye== (**5 Nov 1556**)
Surs = **last Afghan dynasty** to rule Delhi

boxes.title: Administration & revenue: more
items: Officers ==frequently transferred==; Hindus in high army posts
Local headmen detect crime; **censors of public morals**; espionage
Share ⚠ some notes: one-fourth to one-third; **qanungo, patwari** assist Amin

boxes.title: Coins & roads: more
items: Rupiya ==standard for centuries== (APPSC **2017**); reform outlived the Surs
GT Road ⚠ some notes: **Chittagong-Kabul**, about **1,500 miles**
Sarais: shady trees; horses for mail; market towns grew
